title: Singapore to Kuala Lumpur: Cross-Border Family EV Road Trip Guide 2026
subtitle: A 4-day family EV journey from SG to KL via Malacca — VEP guide, border crossing steps, and kid-friendly stops

route.charger: ChargeSini JB Sentral or Legoland car park
route.kidActivities: Legoland Malaysia, JB City Square indoor playground

route.charger: Gentari Pagoh (180kW) or ChargeSini Ayer Keroh
route.kidActivities: Tugu Celestial observation, Malacca River cruise, Jonker Walk night market
KL Bird Park (free-flight aviary), Aquaria KLCC
Petrosains Discovery Centre, Batu Caves, Sunway Lagoon water park

bestFor: Singapore-based families who want a weekend-long Malaysian adventure without flying
tips: Singapore-registered EVs need VEP (Vehicle Entry Permit) — apply at jpj.gov.my at least 2 weeks before travel, costs ~MYR 20 one-time
You also need Touch 'n Go RFID for Malaysian tolls — install before crossing
Your SG EV insurance must cover Malaysia — check with your insurer and bring the green card
The Woodlands Causeway is faster than Tuas for northbound, but queue at immigration can be 30-90 min on Friday evenings
Kids love Legoland — make it your first stop after crossing. There's charging in the Legoland car park
Crucial: Charge to 100% in Singapore before crossing. JB has few fast chargers
Malacca's Jonker Street night market is weekend-only — plan day 2 on a Friday or Saturday
